description: Change video aspect ratio to 9:16 vertical, 1:1 square, or 4:5 portrait. Adds blurred video borders, solid padding, or center crops.

blurAmount.description: Blur strength (5 to 50) for blur_background mode. Default: 20.

hardwareAcceleration.description: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding (VideoToolbox, NVENC, QSV, etc.) when available. Default: true.

inputPath.description: Path to the source video file.

mode.description: Format mode: 'blur_background' adds blurred video borders, 'fit_pad' adds solid color padding, and 'crop_center' zooms and crops the center. Default: 'blur_background'.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the reformatted video.

padColor.description: Background color for fit_pad mode, such as 'black', 'white', or hex '0x1e1e2e'. Default: 'black'.

targetRatio.description: Target aspect ratio: '9:16' for vertical reels, '1:1' for square, '16:9' for horizontal, or '4:5' for portrait. Default: '9:16'.

name: reformat_aspect_ratio
